description: Import the company logo image file located at the Desktop (C:\users\ga\Desktop\company_logo.png) into Lobby Track's badge designer and add it to the visitor badge template. Position the logo appropriately on the badge (e.g., top-left or top-right corner) so it does not obscure visitor name, date, or other critical fields. Save the updated badge template when finished. The logo is a 200x200 pixel PNG image.
